user.title: Alerty
user.description: Observes binary_sensor.alert_* entities (defined in templates/alerting.yaml), sends notifications, keeps a journal and lets you dismiss, mute or disable alerts.

data_description.push_enabled: Off: no push for any alert. Nothing is caught up when switched back on.
data_description.persistent_enabled: Off: no notifications in the HA bell. Nothing is caught up when switched back on.

dismiss.name: Dismiss
dismiss.description: Hides the current occurrence from the active list and stops reminders. The next occurrence notifies normally.

undismiss.name: Restore
undismiss.description: Brings a dismissed occurrence back to the active list (sends nothing).

mute.name: Mute
mute.description: Mutes the alert until unmuted: this and later occurrences send nothing; the alert stays visible.

unmute.name: Unmute
unmute.description: Ends muting. The ongoing occurrence does not catch up the notification, but reminders resume.

disable.name: Disable
disable.description: Disables the alert until enabled: sends nothing and is hidden from the active list.

enable.name: Enable
enable.description: Enables a disabled alert. The ongoing occurrence returns to the list without catching up the notification; reminders resume.

cleanup.name: Clean up notifications
cleanup.description: Dismisses resolved alert notifications older than the configured age and prunes the journal.

orphans.name: Orphans too
orphans.description: Also dismiss alert_* notifications unknown to the integration.

export_journal.name: Export journal
export_journal.description: Returns journal entries (all, not only the last 25).
